title: A day as the sales manager

scenes.title: A day as the sales manager
scenes.subtitle: Rahul keeps the pipeline moving
scenes.narration: Rahul manages the sales team. His job is to see where every deal stands and get the right lead to the right person.
He starts with the deals in negotiation, the ones closest to booking, and checks who owns each one.
New enquiries nobody owns yet wait in Unassigned. He gives them to the consultant with the right destination knowledge.
Before a big quote goes out, he checks the cost, the price and the margin of each item.
The sales report shows won revenue and deals per consultant, so his one-to-ones start from facts.
And when the owner asks for the numbers, he exports the lead list to a spreadsheet.

scenes.headline: Every deal, in view.
scenes.narration: TravelCRM Pro. Every deal, in view.
